name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Francisco Assis
part_text:
The European Parliament is asked to lift the legal protection from Francisco Assis, a Portuguese member, so a Portuguese court can pursue a defamation case against him. The case concerns a 2022 press release he wrote as head of Portugal's Economic and Social Council, before he became a member. Parliament's legal affairs committee found no sign the case is meant to harm his political work, and recommends lifting the protection. Parliament as a whole takes the final decision.

- Parliament would allow a Portuguese court to investigate and possibly try Assis over the 2022 press release.
- It affects Francisco Assis, a Portuguese member of the European Parliament.
- Parliament votes on the committee's recommendation; if approved, Portugal's authorities are told.
